# The Ministry of Doubt

> Suspicion is not proof. Authority is not proof either. Show me the evidence.

Public site for a nonfiction book and planned companion evidence tracker by Colin Dixon (Australia).

## Public pages

- https://ministryofdoubt.com/ — project home
- https://ministryofdoubt.com/book — book overview (no chapter dump)
- https://ministryofdoubt.com/music — companion music (Spotify; OzeAuMusic)
- https://ministryofdoubt.com/author — author
- https://ministryofdoubt.com/tracker — planned evidence ledger (not launched)
- https://ministryofdoubt.com/about — independence and contact

## Not on this site

Working research notes, case dossiers, full outline and manuscript drafts are private and not served from this domain.

## Related public work

- https://electiontracker.au/ — model for sourced public ledgers
